finding_repaired.finding: V3 used one unchecked os.write for the durable UNKNOWN fence, so a partial or zero-progress write could be mislabeled with intended length/digest/durability.
finding_repaired.repair: V4 uses a checked write-all loop, rejects n<=0, verifies file fsync, exact byte-for-byte readback and parent-directory fsync, and publishes bytes/SHA/durable only after every boundary passes. Partial short write, zero write, write exception, file-fsync exception, readback exception and parent-fsync exception remain NON_DURABLE_UNKNOWN without intended bytes/SHA or authoritative PASS claim.

falsifier: Any unchecked fence write; zero progress accepted; partial/truncated file treated authoritative; bytes or SHA reported from intended rather than verified bytes; durable=true before exact readback and both fsync boundaries; surviving PASS marker hidden; post-admission exception escape; or external effect fails v4.
owner: v4 checked-write total UNKNOWN finalizer over preserved v3 observed-readback vertical
